result.title: Interactive Structured Environment Scaling for Large Language Model Agentic Reasoning
result.summary: Reinforcement learning via environmental interaction is a cornerstone post-training paradigm for evolving large language models into autonomous agents capable of multi-turn tool use and exploration. Because the environment defines what the policy observes and how actions are verified, its structure directly bounds the capabilities an agent can acquire. Yet existing structured and retrieval environments rely on upstream pre-filtering---extracting a compact subgraph around the gold answer or retrieving fixed passages before the policy acts. We show that such pre-filtering introduces a fundamental measurement confound: because per-question subgraphs enclose ground-truth paths, they compress the candidate space by orders of magnitude and leak answer locations via local topology, allowing a question-blind degree heuristic to surface gold answers far above chance. To restore path selection, candidate pruning, and optimal stopping as genuine policy decisions, we propose RISE (Interactive Structured Environment), which transitions structured reinforcement learning from static subgraphs to full-scale interactive databases along two coupled axes. First, Decision-Space Scaling exposes the unpruned knowledge graph via a five-stage graph-agnostic typed intent adapter under a bounded call budget and a multiplicative grounding reward gate. Second, Learning-Frontier Scaling overcomes within-group variance collapse under group-normalized objectives by uniting model-independent structural tier progression with a self-evolving competence-frontier bandit. Across nineteen benchmarks and three model backbones, RISE substantially advances in-domain and unseen-schema knowledge-graph reasoning, transfers zero-shot to open-domain passage retrieval, and significantly enhances out-of-domain mathematical and logical deduction.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 RISE，把结构化强化学习环境从上游预筛选的静态子图改为全规模交互式知识图谱，借助五阶段类型化意图适配器、受限调用预算与 grounding 奖励门控扩展决策空间，并用结构层级递进结合能力前沿 bandit 缓解组内方差坍缩。
AI.relevance_reason: 文中指出预筛选子图会通过局部拓扑泄漏答案位置，并把路径选择、候选剪枝与最优停止还原为真实策略决策；这一诊断与评测思路可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据预筛选或裁剪是否造成捷径，以及 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的停止决策是否被环境结构替代。
